description: Realizability audit for the exact irreducible Type-B forced-spectrum family: exact first-20 prefix, sharp first-scale path-union certificates, one fixed-template paired saturation UNSAT certificate, complete Balaban C16 recovery, and a finite witness-preserving 2-switch audit.
scope_note: The fixed-template computation covers one literal minimum-order path embedding for Pi=(2,2,4,4,1,1), not every embedding at order 36, not the other first-twenty tuples, and no higher order. Closure 2-connectivity, T9B, and C16-freeness are deliberately omitted from that model, making its UNSAT conclusion valid for the larger relaxed fixed-embedding class. The Balaban mutation result covers only the stated degree-preserving 2-switch class. ICF remains conjectural; this is not proof-assistant formal verification.

independent_verification: Every minimum-order path union is checked by the project DFS detector and NetworkX. The fixed-template CP-SAT CEGAR clauses contain literal simple C8 witnesses; a from-scratch PySAT sequential-cardinality CNF, not CP-SAT's encoding, independently proves the accumulated instance UNSAT with Glucose3. NetworkX simple_cycles and a separate elementary DFS enumerator agree on the complete canonical set of 3,298 Balaban C16s. Every 2-switch failure stores a literal cycle whose distinct vertices and mutated-graph edges are rechecked.
completed_range: Exact family functions and first 20 ordered tuples; exact path-union optima for t=u=4 and both gaps; all 340 within-bridge edge choices in one fixed Pi0 order-(19,19) embedding subject to the documented relaxed hard constraints; all 3,298 C16s of the exact Balaban-derived bridge; all 826 simple degree-preserving 2-switches that remove an unprotected canonical-C16 edge, preserve both admissible paths, and retain closure biconnectivity. No other embedding, tuple, order, or mutation class is claimed.
